balls.text: really full delivery, the batsman doesn't connect and he will collect a leg bye
edges the slog this time but the third man is placed very fine and he is able to cut off the boundary
Hilarious!  What a legend Sreesanth is .. He tries to play a reverse sweep and Sangwan fires a bouncer that flies past the bat and the face of Sreesanth! Chuckles in the dug out
walks down the track and edges the attempted slog to fine-leg boundary
mvoes down the track and drives it hard to left of long-off where Mithun Manhas makes a fine sliding stop
low dipping full toss on the middle and leg line, squeezed out behind square-leg

Maharoof takes a very good catch at third man.  It was short in length and bouncing outside off, Chawla slashed it off the outer edge towards thirdman where Maharoof took a superb catch diving low forward
rushes down the track and drives to mid-off fora  single
has a big swing and a miss at this one
Whoa! Sreesanth moves outside leg and slaps the short delivery to cover point boundary
on the middle, Piyush backs away to guide it to third man
length delivery outside off, nudged to point
overpitched around leg and middle, driven to long-off
full delivery, lifted to left of Sehwag at long-off
really full delivery, pushed down to long-on
walks down the track, Maharoof slips in a slower one and Sreesanth doesn't pick it all and the ball loops past the bat
charges down the track, Maharoof hurls the bouncer outside off and Sreesanth can't connect with the pull
full and on the middle and leg, turned past square-leg

foe for the yorker, ends up with a very full delivery on the leg stump line, around the boots of Sreesanth who plays a very nice-looking flick shot .. Ah! got fooled there .. it went off his boots apparently says the umpire!
fuller, just outside off stump, moving across, Sreesanth is beaten, trying to dab it to third man
high bouncer and Karthik does really well to stop it from flying over him
low full toss finds Sreesanth's pad. Loud shout for lbw but turned down. It hit him just outside leg stump
The leg stump flies out ... Powar tried to charge at Nannes but the ball was too quick for him .. the leg stump flew out of its peg
bangs it in short,. Powar flat-bats it, forehand down the line, over the umpire
around 143 kmph .. full, fast and moving across Powar who tries to run it down to third man but can't get wood on leather
full in length, driven uppishly but it falls short of the diving Maharoof at mid-off
around the off stump line, squeezed out to backward point
full in length around off stump line, defended on the front foot
length delivery outside off, tapped behind the wicket ..
low full toss and Bopara connects really well with the whippy flick but finds the deep square-leg fielder.
overpitched outside off, driven straight to cover
full delivery on the off stump line, pushed out to cover
superbly done by Mishra. He followed the googly with a tossed-up delivery, slower in pace, and wider outside off, Kaif was down the track for the big hit and was stumped
another googly, this time turns from the off stump line, jabbed away
googly on middle and leg, clipped past square-leg
on the off stump line, pushed to right of cover where AB makes a fine diving stop and quickly releases a throw at the non-striker's end
full delivery, flicked away to deep square-leg
leans forward to wrist it away for a single
gets forward to on drive for a single
very fine hit over midwicket. Kaif, with some stunningly gawdy shiny  pads, reached forward to fetch a flighted delivery around off stump and flicked it over midwicket!
on the middle stump line, Kaif dabs it to midwicket
Irfan charges down the track and Dilshan, very cleverly, slowed up the pace and also shortened the length ... Irfan didn't connect and Karthik did the rest
pulls this one to midwicket
More runs in the third-man region. Full and outside off and this time, its Irfan who gets the big fat edge on the intended off drive
full in length and outside off, driven to long-off
goes for the yorker, ends up as a low dipping full toss, flicked past square-leg. 50 up for Bopara.
full and moving across Bopara who goes for the big off  drive and gets a lucky edge down to third man boundary
full and straight, driven back to the bowler
full and on the leg and middle line, bounds off bat and pad to square-leg
gets forward to ping long-off
fuller just outside off, driven down to long-off
googly outside off stump, short in length, cut away to sweeper cover
slows up the pace, tosses it wider outside off, Bopara waits on the front foot and drags it down to long-on
googly on the middle and leg, Bopara is hit on the pad
flighted delivery that dips rapidly outside off, Bopara goes for the sweep but can't connect
around the off stump line, eased to long-on
Flamboyant pull. It was banged in short and Bopara swivels to play a neat-looking shot
bouncing delivery outside off, edged to third man
backs away and lifts it over mid-off .. Gambhir rushes back and makes a desperate attempt but the ball falls just ahead of his reach
clears the front foot and goes for the good-old slog and it lands safely between deep midwicket and long-on
length delivery around off and middle, punched down to long-on
moves down the track, fetches the ball from around off stump and drags it to wide midwicket boundary
goes back to punch it past point
leans across to defend to the off side
stays back to tap it straight to backward point where Nannes makes a right royal mess of a simple stop.... there shouldn't have been any run ..
on the leg and middle, swept away for a single
leans forward to turn it to midwicket

driven to the off side.. Yo Mahesh makes a diving stop .. Bopara was down the track, looking for a single, and Mahesh's throw misses the stumps at the striker's end with Bopara rushing back. Had it hit, Bopara would have been a goner. Over throws results as the ball goes past the keeper
fullish around off, driven crisply to cover where Sehwag makes a half-stop
full and straight, around off, pushed to right of mid-off
full delivery, flicked past square-leg
gets forward to push it to mid-on
and this one tails down the leg side
full and almost wide outside off, Bopara chases it and edges the intended square drive to third man boundary
googly on the middle and leg, clipped past square-leg
flighted delivery,  Bopara top edges the sweep to fine=leg boundary
loopy flighted delivery and driven one bounce to Mishra who takes it and throws it in the air as if he had taken a catch!
flighted delivery outside off, Bopara tries to play the paddle sweep and makes a complete mess of it
flighted full around off and middle, on driven to long-on
gets forward to push it to cover
full pitched delivery around off, driven to cover
drops it slightly short and that's enough licence for Bopara to unfurl the pull shot
really full delivery around off, driven to mid-off
yorker length just outside off, dug out to the off side
banged in short, pulled away weakly behind square-leg
44 for 4. Punjab are wobbling here in Mohali. It seemed an harmless length delivery well outside off stump, Mahela chased it but ended up with a thin nick.

Massive wicket this. Yuvraj Singh is gone. Full in length and Yuvraj went for the straight lofted hit but took his bottom-hand off the point of impact and the ball went really really high. Gambhir back-pedaled from mid-on to take a good catch.
tries a variation in pace this time, slips in a slower one but Yuvraj picks it early and pulls it away to the midwicket boundary
walks a couple of steps down the track, Maharoof holds his calm and bowls yet another off cutter in the zone outside off, left alone again
cuts away from the off stump, left alone
in the zone outside off, slanting away, left alone
lands outside off and moves away even further ... wide
Full pitched around the  leg stump, Sangakkara must have thought it as a boundary opportunity and flicked it but it went low towards short fine-leg where Sangwan took a good catch lunging forward

backs to the leg side and slices the length delivery on the up and over backward point. Not quite controlled, not entirely where he wanted it to go but he went through with the shot and that helped him clear the infield
jumps down the track, goes for the big hit but Sangwan fires it fuller and the ball goes under the bat
full in length on the middle and off line, pushed to the on side of the pitch and the bowler makes a tumbling stop
around the off stump line, driven to cover
gets forward to tap it to the on side
superbly done. It was a back-of-length delivery slanting across Bopara who played a deft back-foot punchy drive well to the left of backward point
yorker length on the middle, dug out to cover
around the off stump line, pushed out to point
Awesome hit. Sanga sashays down the track and lifts the length delivery right over to the straight boundary.
cuts in towards middle and leg, clipped past square-leg
Shot! Bopara plays a powerful pull shot and Preity Zinta jumps in joy. It was a short delivery and he played it rather nonchalantly

short in length and bouncing away, Sangakkara edges the attempted cut and the ball rolls behind the wicket ...AB comes from the slip and fires a throw at the non-strikers' end, misses and the ball runs away to the boundary
really full delivery outside off, the keeper collects
full and well outside off stump, Bopara chases it with an attempted drive but doesn't connect
full and on the leg stump line, rolls away off the pad
moves outside leg stump, Nannes follows him, jabbed off the inner edge to on side
good probing delivery, moving across the batsman at some pace .. beaten as he pushes inside the line
full delivery, hint of away swing, Sanga stands rooted at his crease and squeezes it to third man
run down to third man for a single
good off cutter, opens-up Sanga who stabs it off the outer edge to third man and the ball rushes past the lunging Nannes at the boundary
cuts in with  bounce, tucked behind square-leg for a single
fuller, hint of in swing, on the middle stump line, Bopara stabs it off the inner edge to square-leg
slips this one down the leg side ..
Bisla is run out He pushes a length delivery towards extra cover and rushes across. Manhas swoops on the ball and fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Gone! Super stuff from Mithun
banged in short, Bisla top edges the pull and it sails over midwicket.. Mishra runs back but doesn't reach it .. it hung long enough in the air
Pace is too hot for Bisla to handle ..  kicks up even as it straightens from short of length and moves past the defensive prod to strike the thigh pad
on the middle stump line, slanting away, dabbed to backward point
lovely pacy delivery that moves away this time and Bisla is beaten for pace and by the movement
around 140 kmph length delivery that straightens, Bisla is beaten for pace and the ball thuds into the thigh pad
on the pads, rolls off the pad to fine-leg region
pacy length delivery curving in on the middle stump line, pushed out to the off side
some swing but it moves down the leg side ...
backs away, Irfan bows it short and outside off, Mithun Manhas, a former captain of of the Delhi Ranji trophy team, slaps it over point! Delhi Daredevils have won!
high full toss around waist-high, swatted to long-off.. Maharoof says it was surely above waist.. the umpire is checking with the tv ump ... not a no ball says the tv ump ... one run left
fullish on the middle and leg, backs away to edge the drive to right of midwicket where Powar makes a diving half-stop

Is there a final twist yet in the tale? Gambhir backs away to the leg side, Irfan tries to follow him, serves a full toss on the leg stump line, Gambhir tries to swing it to the on side and gets a leading edge to mid-off.
around the off stump line, pushed to point for a quick single.. it needed a direct hit but Bopara misses the stumps
short in length, bounces outside off, Gambhir tries to run it to third man but no wood on leather
What a stunning hit. The delhi camp erupts in joy. Gambhir backs away to lift it superbly over long-off and boy is he pumped or what .. he lets out a scream
fullish on the leg and middle stump line, flicked away for a single
Whack! Bravo Mithun! He rushed down the track to crash the length delivery to wide long-off boundary
yorker arrives now.. dug out back down the pitch
Dropped by Irfan at long-off. What a clanger! It was the slower one and Manhas ended up scooping it high towards long-off where Irfan makes a right royal mess of it
on the middle stump line, good tight line and length ,swatted to midwicket for a quick single
short in length, bounces over middle, stump line, mistimes the pull towards long-on and since the ball traveled slowly, Gambhir pushes for the second run
swing and a miss. Length delivery shaping away from the off stump, Manhas can't connect. Two good overs so far ...
good swinging full delivery, curves in full on the middle stump line,, again jabbed off the inner edge to square-leg
Inside edge to the boundary. Gambhir clears the front foot and went for a big swing across the line  .. not a judicious attempt but he gets lucky
run out chance missed Manhas dabbed to point and got across for a single.. Had Kaif hit the stumps at the non-striker's end , Manhas would have been out
slows up the pace, Manhas works this one to long-off for a single. Good over from Yuvraj
flicks this straight to midwicket and gets across for the quick single
full and outside off stump, again mistimes the shot to cover .. two dot balls in a row ..
around off stump, pushed out to cover .. Gambhir is not happy with himself
quicker one, punched to long-off
outside off stump and cut down to backward point
leans across to drive to sweeper cover
turns to the leg stump line, dabbed past square-leg
leans forward to drive tolong-off
pushed towards midwicket ... no one there and by the time bowler ran across, they get back for the second
turns away from the stumps, cut to left of backward point where Kaif makes a diving stop ... and throws to non-striker where Chawla doesn't collect ... And Kaif isn't too happy with the effort
reaches forward to lift it to left of Powar at long-off
outside off stump, cut to right of point where a diving half-stop is done
full toss but Gambhir swings it straight to deep backward square-leg
on the middle and leg,really full delivery, nudged to short fine-leg
fuller, around off stump line, tapped to short third man and Gambhir rushes for the single and makes it in time to beat the throw
on the middle stump line punched towards non-striker.. Yuvraj gets across to make the stop
He keeps cutting the spinners. Will pick up a single this time

quicker one from round the stumps, skids on, Gambhir stays back to cut it to deep backward point region where Sreesanth makes a diving stop near the boundary .. 16 runs from the over ... bonanza for Delhi
What a top shot. Gambhir rushes down the track, gets outside the line of the flighted delivery and drives it past the non-striker and to the straight boundary
opens his stance to pull it to wide long-on region .. 50 for Gambhir ..
stays back to cut it to cover where Kaif makes a mess of a regulation stop.
i t was on the middle and off line, Gambhir creates his own room by backing away and playing it very late .. as he cuts to backward point boundary
goes back to work it past square-leg
gets forward to off drive this one
drifts ever so gently down the leg side and Gambhir glances it away to the boundary
fine yorker on the off stump line, dug out .. the ball rolls behind the wicket. Gambhir rushes across, Sanga throws his gloves and has a shy at the striker's end .. misses and Gmabhir was home anyway
slower one on the off stump line, run down to third man
short in length and bouncing outside off, Karthik flat bats it towards long-off and Irfan rushes in to take a tumbling catch. The game is fascinatingly poised now. Gambhir is still out there.
goes for the yorker, dips on the leg stump line, and hits the pad ... probably just missing leg stump
Aaha! a fine reverse paddle. It was around off stump line, reverse paddled to third man boundary
really full, pushed to left of cover .. they think about a single but change their mind.
goes down on a bent knee to play a fierce slog sweep to wide midwicket boundary
quicker one on the off stump line, cut to point
reaches forward to ping long-off
superbly played late cut. It was turning in to the off stump line, Gambhir waited on the back foot to play the delicate late cut
slows up the pace, holds back the length, driven to cover
gets down the track and lifts it towards Powar at sweeper cover
reaches forward to play the chip shot towards long-on
really full delivery on the off and middle, square driven to deep point
on the leg stump line, taps it to short fine -leg fielder
opens his stance up and mistimes the pull shot towards long-on

Almost run out He charged down the track and drove it to right of cover where Bopara makes a fine diving stop and throws it to the keeper who breaks the stumps. Had it been a direct hit, Gambhir would have been out
gets down the track and almost yorks himself .. dug out to the bowler
goes down on his knee to sweep it deep midwicket
moves down the track to ping Powar at long-on
quicker one, skids on just outside off but Gambhir backs away to play a fine cut shot to the boundary
around off and middle, squeezed of the outer edge through point
pushes this one towards mid-on for a single
well outside off stump, dabbed towards point
gets forward to drive to left of long-off for couple of runs
slower one, full and around off, pushed out to cover
chips the length delivery uppishly but short of mid-on
fullish delivery outside off stump, Karthik unfurls a gorgeous off drive between mid-off and extra cover
pushes this one through point
loud shout for lbw ... slider on the middle and leg ...goes past the defensive prod and strikes the pad on the leg stump line.. would have probably gone down leg
cuts this one to deep point

AB is run out  It was dabbed to short third man, Gambhir sets off for a single before sending AB back .. Mahela throws it to Chawla who is slow in reacting ... gropes in dark so to speak but manages to find the stumps eventually .. AB tried to dive back in the crease but his bat lifted up in the air
around off stump, cut away to backward point
moves down the track to flick it past square-leg for couple of runs
charges down the track and squeezes it past square-leg
slower one outside off stump, Gambhir is beaten on the cut
slow off cutter around off stump, tapped to the off side, one look at each other and they are off
low outswinging full toss outside off stump, Gambhir creams it to deep point region
full and swinging away from Gambhir who chases it with a loose drive away from the body and doesn't connect
swings in to the leg and middle, worked away to long-leg
just outside off stump, Gambhir waits for the ball to arrive before opening the bat-face and playing a very deft late cut to third-man boundary
on the off stump line, skids on, tapped to the on side for a single
pushes it full and across Gambhir who flashes it to deep point where Piyush makes a very fine tumbling stop
full delivery around off, swings away late, driven to right of extra cover where there is a fumble
on the middle and off line, run down to third man .
length delivery slides in to roll off the thigh pad
on the middle stump line, nudged behind square-leg
curves in towards the middle stump line, AB gets forward to defend it cautiously back down the pitch
goes down on a bent knee to square drive it to cover point
pushes it wide outside off stump
swings in from outside off, AB plays the off drive, takes the bottom-hand off the handle, but goes through with the shot and the ball races away to mid-off
short in length and outside off, mistimes the cut to cover
outside off stump, sweetly driven but can't beat mid-off
sprays it wide outside off stump
short in length and outside off, cut away to backward point

lovely swinging delivery on the off and middle line, outswinger for the right-hand batsmen ie . it swings in to the left-handed Gambhir who edges the off drive back down the pitch and Sreesanth dives to his right to stop
slower one outside off stump, GAmbhir is beaten as he cuts a tad too early .. Sreesanth smiles and so does Gambhir
full and outside off stump this time, jabbed out to the off side
full in length and on the leg and middle line, Gambhir plays a neat pick-up shot over square-leg. He just wristed it up and over the in field
from very close to the stumps, length delivery on middle, turned past square-leg

drifts to the pads, glanced away to the fine-leg boundary. Both Irfan and Gambhir look eagerly at the umpire .. Irfan obviously was hoping for a leg bye signal and Gambhir for the four signal and its signaled a leg bye
Crash. Fullish and outside off stump, Gambhir square drives it to the point boundary.

almost a run out  around the middle and off line .. pushed to backward point .. confusion between the two .. Kaif throws it towards the non-striker's end .. Pathan rushes back, lunges to grab the throw and then flicks at the stumps but misses .. and AB dives to get back in the crease .. no on to back up
in the channel outside off stump, around 123 kmph, Gambhir is beaten on the attempted square drive
on the middle stump line, gentle swing, worked through midwicket. For Gambhir, Sanga is standing up to the stumps
yet another curvy outswinger around off stump line, squeezed out to point
Double strike. Double jeopardy for Delhi. Full delivery on the middle and leg and DIlshan flicks it straight to Bisla at short midwicket. The Punjab camp go berserk and the crowd love it as well.
another good outswinger, Dilshan tries to steer it and is beaten
on the middle stump line, pushed back to the bowler
Lovely outswinger from Sreesanth takes out Sehwag. Sehwag was looking for the big off drive and was done in by the outswing. It flew to first slip where Mahela pouched it
short in length and outside off stump, reaches out to cut it down to third man
short in length, just outside off stump, flashed away off the back foot to point boundary
around the off stump, driven to cover
around the off and middle, squeezed out to short midwicket
on the middle stump line, curves in, Sehwag, who has opened -up his stance slightly for Irfan's inswing I guess, whips it through midwicket
around the off stump line, run down to third man for a single
